notes.title: Antonblast Release
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42990367/9d3568d4c479ef6da9104f71bc4279613e228cb4.png

The wait is finally over. After a very successful Kickstarter in 2022 and 100,000 wishlists later, Antonblast has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887400/ANTONBLAST/

ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends!

     BLAST through a unique powertrip of a platformer!
     INDULGE in an urban graffiti-inspired art style!
     DEMOLISH massive destructible environments!
     BATTLE brutal, earthshaking bosses!
     EXPERIMENT with a totally dynamic playstyle; rush through for the best time or explore at your own pace!



FEATURES


     Shock and Awe! Unlike other platforming heroes, Anton's not content to stay in his lane. Jet between the foreground and background layers for 2.5d platforming action!
     Destructible Everything! Use Anton's mighty hammer to break down your environments!
     Hurry Up! It's Happy Hour! Once Anton gets to the end of a level, set off the Spirit Detonator and dash back to the start before everything blows!
     12 unique sprawling worlds with tons to explore!
     Dynamic play style - rush to the end or explore at your own pace!
     Silky smooth platforming gameplay with best-in-class controls!
     Breathtaking hand-drawn animation!
     Brutal earthshaking bosses!
     A groovy, retro-flavored dynamic soundtrack!
     Loads of replay value: Hard Mode, Boss Rush, and more!

https://youtu.be/IYqE7h1YNUA?si=Y1q6RAqWK7fWW_Fb

notes.title: Into the HIVE! - Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hey, you beautiful cluckers!
The third hotfix pack is here with some eggcelent goodies:


 Fixed a bug where the wrong character spoke in the wrong voice in a specific dialogue.
 Fixed several typos, we will continue to do this (a long script, you know...)
 Fixed a bug in the Glass Shard minigame
 We also fixed and tweaked the collider of collectibles, so they are a bit easier to pick up (especially with a controller)
 Made several small graphical polishes
 Slightly changed the opening text of the credits because unfortunately, some people misunderstood it (in a quite negative way). Now our message is the same, but more simple and clear.
 And we made some system-wide code fixes for a much smoother and more fluid gameplay experience. (too boring to list)


Thank you for playing and loving our game! 
Have fun, and continue to be awesome!

We will come back with more fixes and enhancements soon!
Be safe, and play more!
The Wild Gentlemen

notes.title: Into the HIVE! - Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
The second hotfix pack is here, cluckers!


 Fixed the dialogue where Sonny and Marty weirdly merged together (no it wasn't an intentional 3-headed monkey reference from Monkey Island...)
 The same dialogue accidentally had Moses speaking instead of Sonny at one point, creating a strange ventriloquist effect. Corrected.
 Fixed a graphical bug in the movie studio interior - missing chair leg.
 Fixed a bug in the card game, also of a graphical nature.
 The background of the minigame tutorials has also been adjusted.
 Uncle Joe had a missing dialogue part (a bug of a bug), fixed that.
 Fixed a cutscene where a date appeared wrong.
 Lupus was shaking strangely in one of his poses, which was partially on purpose, but a bit overdone. We fixed that too.
 
More improvements and updates are to come. 
Don't forget to leave a review if you enjoyed the game, and have a cluckin' amazing day!
The Wild Gentlemen

notes.title: Into the HIVE! - Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Our first hotfix is already here, Everyone!


 Fixed an issue that could cause a 30 FPS cap for some people.


Hope you are enjoying the game!

Have a great one, cluckers!
The Wild Gentlemen
